items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Tommy Myles. I don’t know.

ctx.x: Did the name Tommy Myles – does that mean anything to you?

He had the band at the Lincoln Colonnade that I understand that in his band – I’ve actually seen pictures – John Malachi was in that band, Tommy Myles’s band. Tommy Potter was in that band. I’m trying to think of the arranger – Jimmy Mundy was also . . .
